Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B). Earlier history: minified baseline 2026-10-03 admin-event-editor 1429/737, admin-event-text-limits 998/539, auth-status 2081/1009, avatar 287/213, copy-link 1323/714, events-calendar 5133/1991, going-count 2289/1092, member-profile 6138/2414, past-events 3350/1397, rsvp-button 13662/4001, styles 4749/1611; baseline 2026-09-30 events-calendar 8108/2793, going-count 2776/1145, member-profile 5193/1977, past-events 3778/1434, styles 2087/882. Every JavaScript file under public/islands at any depth and every top-level public/*.css file must have a budget. Raising a ceiling requires an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget just to make CI green. assets/ holds the reviewed sources for islands and styles.css; public/ holds the deterministic build output for those (node ci/minify-assets.mjs --check fails on drift). Theme stylesheets are served as authored. Served behavior is unchanged: the binder suite executes the minified bytes. schedule-theme raw ceiling 5632 covers the measured clean-text merge 5444/1468 (calendar month-jump plus member-board/archive growth) with one 512B raw step; gzip ceiling is unchanged at 1536 per the auth-status precedent. 2026-10-20 reconciliation (calendar subscription help merge current main): the merge-base file is 4621B; this PR's subscription-help disclosure rules (+489B to 5110B) and main's viewer-row sticky/aria-current/forced-colors plus archive-state rules (+491B to 5112B) each fit the 5120B ceiling alone, but the combined authored file measures 5601B raw (CI identical), 481B over. The selector sets are disjoint, so no consolidation is available without changing either reviewed feature's presentation; theme stylesheets are served as authored with no minify step. Only the breached raw ceiling moves, one 512B step to 5632B (31B margin; deterministic authored bytes, so no rebuild wobble). Deliberately far below x1.25 (7168B). Gzip (1509/1536B) and every other ceiling stay fixed and fail-closed.
